sn47.37:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.37:1.4: tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato yo kāyasmiṃ chando so pahiyyati
sn47.37:2.1: vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.37:2.2: tassa vedanāsu vedanānupassino viharato yo vedanāsu chando so pahiyyati
sn47.37:3.1: citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.37:3.2: tassa citte cittānupassino viharato yo cittasmiṃ chando so pahiyyati
sn47.37:4.1: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.37:4.2: tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato yo dhammesu chando so pahiyyati
